name: Favor Amongst the Darkspear
label: Quest
description: Favor Amongst the Darkspear: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before the night elves existed there was troll. It was from troll that the night elves came.
Their mutinous attacks against my people will not be tolerated. Staghelm seeks to wipe us out - to leave no trace of those that bore him and his ilk. It will not happen!

For every night elf that you slay and decapitate, Najak will grant you favor amongst the Darkspear. Word of your deeds will be spread across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Go now and serve the Darkspear!

clips.title: Progress
paras: They seek to exterminate us? It is they who shall be exterminated.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, it is but one of thousands. A job well done nonetheless.
